metadata.ordering_caveat: replay_menu_position is the progress-menu display order inside each chapter filter. It is not an unlock order and must not be used as a prerequisite chain.
blockers: No game executable in the dump, so no key material and no native tables
RPF9 name tables are encrypted, so extracted files have no names
Script objects in script.rpf and story000_script.rpf use 32-bit hashed identifiers and block-cipher-encrypted string tables (LSNS)
67% of story000_script.rpf (52.2 MB in 31 regions) is neither zlib nor plaintext
No localized text table was found in readable form, so display titles are unavailable

The decompiled scripts reference strings only as heap offsets (Vm.StringConstant) and the heap is not included, natives are mostly unnamed hashes, and mission scripts reference only their own mission ID, so availability conditions were not found in script code
